summaries.text:
Fair Repair Act
 This bill requires an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) to make diagnostic, maintenance, and repair equipment available to independent repair providers and owners.
 Specifically, for digital electronic equipment manufactured by or otherwise supplied by an OEM, an OEM shall make documentation, parts, and tools available in a timely manner and on fair and reasonable terms.
 The bill provides for enforcement of its provisions by the Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general.
